title: stable (infinity,1)-category
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch1 导言 0.6 定义稳定 ∞-范畴、t-结构、Lurie 张量积，全书取值范畴
definition_zh: 稳定 (∞,1)-范畴是指带有限极限、带零对象，且环路函子 Ω 为等价（其逆为悬挂函子 Σ）的 (∞,1)-范畴。等价地，它是被充实于谱的 ∞-范畴、其取值落在谱的 ∞-范畴 Sptr 之中，其同伦范畴自动带有三角结构。Lurie 在 Higher Algebra 中证明「稳定」不是额外结构而是 ∞-范畴的一条性质，因此任何稳定 ∞-范畴都典范地被充实于 Sptr。
key_points: 两种等价刻画：Lurie 的定义（有限极限 + Ω 为等价）与「充实于 Sptr 的 ∞-范畴」；后者的好处是充实结构自动得到，无需额外数据。
稳定 ∞-范畴上可以谈论 t-结构；心 C♡ = C^{≤0} ∩ C^{≥0} 是 abelian 范畴，截断函子 τ^{≤0}、τ^{≥0} 分别给出伴随 C^{≤0} ⇄ C ⇄ C^{≥0}。
完全余完备的稳定 ∞-范畴与保余极限函子构成 ∞-范畴 1-Cat^{St,cocmpl}_{cont}，它带有对称幺半结构（Lurie 张量积），并由 A ⊗ B 的右伴随给出内 Hom 的刻画；三角范畴无法定义这一张量积。
紧生成性：由紧对象生成的稳定 ∞-范畴等价于某个 DG 范畴的导出范畴式模型，这给出稳定 ∞-范畴与 DG 范畴之间的对照（DAG 第一卷 §0.6.11 即据此定义 DGCat_cont）。
idea_original: A stable (∞,1)-category CC, is a pointed (∞,1)-category with finite (∞,1)-limit which is stable under forming loop space objects: CC has a zero object and the corresponding loop (∞,1)-functor Ω:C→C \Omega : C \to C is an equivalence with inverse the suspension object functor C←C:Σ. C \leftarrow C : \Sigma \,. This means that the objects of a stable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category are stable in the sense of stable homotopy theory: they behave as if they were spectra. Indeed, every (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category with finite limits has a free stabilization to a stable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category Stab(C)Stab(C), and the objects of Stab(C)Stab(C) are the spectrum objects of CC. The homotopy category of an (∞,1)-category of a stable ∞\infty-category is a triangulated category. Notice that the definition of triangulated categories is involved and their behaviour is bad, whereas the definition of stable ∞\infty-category is simple and natural. The complexity and bad behavior of triangulated categories comes from them being the decategorification of a structure that is natural in higher category theory.
references: Jacob Lurie, Higher Algebra, Definition 1.1.2.1 and Section 1.4 (stable infinity-categories), available at https://www.math.ias.edu/~lurie/papers/HA.pdf
Jacob Lurie, Derived Algebraic Geometry I: Stable Infinity-Categories, arXiv:math/0608228
Stefan Schwede, Brooke Shipley, Stable model categories are categories of modules, Topology 42 (2003), no. 1, 103-153
